# tools

[Project overview](../README.md)

Reproducible generation, independent checks and release packaging.

`build_electronics.py` requires KiCad Python (`pcbnew`) and normally overwrites native layouts. Use `--schematic-only` when intentionally preserving routing. Run `finalize_board.py` with KiCad Python after importing the matching route session. `export_review.py`, `check_electronics.py`, `update_evidence.py`, mechanical builds and release validation use the project venv. See the root README for the safe committed-board workflow.
